account.note: One AI Studio project serves every Gemini and Gemma target below, so the quota group is named once and shared; a second client on the same project must join it rather than believe it owns the whole budget.

clients.name: google_gemma_31b

chat_routes.name: smart_gemini
chat_routes.policy: MEASURED: the pool orders by this deployment's own observations (completion, then latency) once a candidate has enough of them, so a replacement model is adopted without a config change. Ordering is a cost and quality decision over one credential at one price, which is why it is a passthrough rather than a composite.
